remarks: Welcome home to a spacious and nicely updated corner unit in Lake Terrace. This 1 bedroom, 1 bath home features a large patio, private laundry, and tons of community amenities to feel like you're living at a luxury resort. Stroll along the walkways to enjoy the well manicured landscaping and waterways, on your way to the tennis courts that are just steps away. Hot days will be cool relaxing pool side!    Featuring updated kitchen and bathroom finishes, brand new carpet in the bedroom, fresh paint throughout the interior, and stylish laminate floors in the living/dining rooms and kitchen.
